title: Stone + Light Residence
brief: A layered home where stone, soft timber tones, and open transitions create a calm daily rhythm.
overview: Built around changing light, this residence pairs grounded stone planes with lighter internal volumes. Openings are positioned to frame landscape rather than expose the home, creating a sense of retreat within the city.
Inside, custom joinery and muted upholstery soften the architectural shell. A consistent palette moves across rooms so the experience feels continuous without becoming uniform.
